plan: Implement a binary decomposition approach where each bit of k corresponds to a small gadget (2-3 instructions), building a program of O(log k) instructions that executes exactly k steps.

Implement a binary decomposition where k's bits from MSB-1 down to LSB each produce 2-3 instruction gadgets, using stack markers to trigger "replay" behavior, achieving O(log k) program size and near-perfect scores.

Build a binary-decomposition construction where each bit of k adds ~2 instructions, achieving O(log k) program size. The construction uses nested loops: a "double" gadget pushes elements that each require 2 steps to process, and an "add-1" gadget adds an extra push/pop cycle for set bits.
